description_expanded: Overview5.0(6 reviews)DESTIN – Emerald Grande West 1129 Harborfront Condo | Stunning Views | Sleeps 8 DESCRIPTION Welcome to Emerald Grande West 1129, a beautifully appointed 3-bedroom, 3-bath condo at Emerald Grande with sweeping views of the Destin Harbor, Gulf of Mexico and Crab Island. Living room features 75" flat screen TV and flat screen smart TV’s in all bedrooms w/ cable. With upscale finishes, comfortable furnishings, and unbeatable access to dining and entertainment, this is your front-row seat to the best of Destin. Guests have full access to world-class amenities, including a zero-entry outdoor pool, an indoor heated pool for rainy days, two hot tubs, a well equipped fitness center, and a luxurious spa. With on-site fine dining, boutique shops and HarborWalk Village just steps away, everything you need for the perfect beach getaway is right here. OUTDOOR LIVING & BEACH ACCESS Two private balconies let you enjoy the sea breeze all day long. Guests can relax by the pool, soak in the hot tub, or take a scenic boat ride to the private beach. HOME FEATURES 3 bedrooms | 3 bathrooms | Sleeps 8 Fully equipped kitchen Gulf views Ferry ride to the beach included with your stay (runs every 30 minutes from spring through fall) DINING & ENTERTAINMENT Direct access to HarborWalk Village restaurants & shops Walk to waterfront dining, bars, and live music Activities for all ages: fishing charters, paddleboards, and dolphin tours WHY STAY HERE? Stunning sunsets from your balcony Ideal for families or couples Here you’ll find waterfront shopping, rentals for paddle boards, jet skis, and pontoons, dolphin cruises, pirate ship excursions, live entertainment, fireworks, and great dining—all just steps away. SLEEPING ACCOMMODATIONS 2 King bedrooms 1 Queen bedroom Emerald Grande West 1129 blends luxury, location, and leisure into the ultimate Destin vacation experience.Show less
